statement: The source method changed from Historic England NHLE ArcGIS Hub filtered GeoJSON retrieval to Ordnance Survey OS OpenMap–Local official product/sample-data documentation. The official OS page confirms important buildings and functional sites and identifies Exeter as a sample-data area, but the selected public no-login documentation window does not expose any record-level Exeter building polygon with same-record explicit type/use evidence. Source-area/product metadata is retained without parcel/building progress credit; no geometry or type/use value was inferred.
